facts.detail: Fee due at admission $75.00; annual renewal fee $25.00 due January 15; no fee for an attorney employed by the Tribes; per Supplemental Court Rule 2011-1 dated 4/22/11.

facts.title: 4.2.1.140 Professional Attorneys (Admission to Practice)
facts.detail: Code section says attorneys may practice if admitted, and sets admission requirements including active good standing in the New Mexico bar or eligibility before another state or federal court; a separate subsection covers admission of lay counsel or spokesmen (enrolled members aged 21 or older of good moral character).
facts.quote: Professional attorneys may practice before the Courts of the Pueblo of San Ildefonso provided that any such attorney is admitted to practice before the Court.
facts.note: Code text read; page is the Pueblo’s code site; currency of the code not stated.

facts.title: Title 4 Judiciary, Chapter 4.2 Court Procedures
facts.detail: Chapter covers court decorum, exhibits, rules of evidence, rules governing jury trial and admission of counsel.
facts.note: Code chapter, not a separate rules of procedure document.

facts.court: Pueblo of Pojoaque Legal Aid Office
facts.title: Legal Services (Pueblo of Pojoaque Legal Aid Office)
facts.detail: Page describes a Legal Aid Office helping members of the Pueblo with legal assistance, document and case review, staffed by a Tribal Member Legal Advocate.
facts.locator: Pueblo of Pojoaque Legal Aid Office
facts.quote: The mission of the Pueblo of Pojoaque Legal Aid Office is helping those judicially challenged members
